rows.comment: Austrian writer-director Michael Haneke has made many a masterpiece
rows.verdict_le10: Austrian writer-director Michael Haneke has made many a masterpiece
rows.dek_lead: Austrian writer-director Michael Haneke has made many a masterpiece – and his latest, Happy End, isn’t one of them. Yet this cinematic poke in the eye about an upper class family imploding still exerts a perverse fascination.
